session_note: Ohio's 136th General Assembly is a continuous two-year session (2025-2026); bills carry over automatically from 2025 into 2026 without any formal carryover action, and the GA does not adjourn sine die until around December 2026. As of 2026-07-31 the session is still ongoing, so bills sitting in committee with no adverse action remain 'in_committee' rather than 'carried_over' or 'failed_died'.
